result.summary: Downloads qa-assets once in a dedicated preparation GitHub Actions job and distributes test vectors and fuzz corpus inputs to consumer jobs as workflow artifacts. Consumer jobs across Linux, macOS, and Windows verify the asset revision and file hashes before running tests. Fuzz jobs make writable copies of the corpus while containerized test jobs mount shared inputs read-only.
result.problem: Multiple CI jobs independently download identical qa-assets during every workflow run, causing redundant network traffic and intermittent HTTP 504 gateway timeouts that fail CI runs before tests start.
evidence: Referenced issue #36814: 'ci: Repeated downloads of shared test assets cause intermittent job failures', where repeated asset downloads fail with HTTP 504 gateway timeouts (PR description and commit 4bdc3e2b38).
result.scope_notes: Touches CI workflow files and runner setup scripts across 8 files without modifying node source code.
result.card: Downloads qa-assets once per GitHub Actions workflow run in a dedicated setup job and distributes test vectors and fuzz corpora as workflow artifacts. Currently, each CI job independently downloads identical test assets, intermittently triggering HTTP 504 timeouts and failing CI runs before tests can begin (#36814). Downstream consumer jobs across platforms verify revision and file hashes before use, mounting inputs read-only or copying them for fuzzing.

risk.why: A bug in artifact generation or verification could break CI workflow runs for contributors.
